step1.title: Chrono-Ring
step1.body: The timer ring counts down the current phase. FOCUS is deep work, BREAK is rest.

step2.title: Phases
step2.body: FOCUS — concentration (25 min by default). BREAK — a rest (5 min). Cycles repeat automatically.

step3.title: XP stake
step3.body: Each focus session earns XP (100 by default). Interrupting after 30 seconds gives partial XP.

step4.title: Bind a task
step4.body: Optional: bind the session to a task from Planning. Focus time is credited to that task's analytics.

step5.title: Settings
step5.body: Focus duration (5–60 min) and break duration (1–15 min), plus background music for each phase.

step6.title: Start
step6.body: START begins the session, PAUSE/RESUME pauses it, RESET clears it. When it ends, a reward screen appears.

complete.title: COURSE COMPLETE
complete.body: The Chrono-Ring is ready. Deep work is your edge, operative.
